rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something at an advanced level, especially a more difficult or specialized option such as 進階設定.

example.english: This is an advanced setting; if you’re not familiar with computers, don’t change it randomly.
example.traditional: 呢個係進階設定，唔熟電腦就唔好亂改。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 zeon3 gaai1 cit3 ding6 m4 suk6 din6 nou5 zau6 m4 hou2 lyun6 goi2

rows.note: Use this for a prototype, product, or project that has progressed substantially and is well developed rather than merely being difficult.

example.english: This advanced version is now mature enough for official release.
example.traditional: 呢個版本已經成熟，可以正式推出喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 baan2 bun2 ji5 ging1 sing4 suk6 ho2 ji5 zing3 sik1 teoi1 ceot1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for an advanced educational level, class, or course.

example.english: I signed up for an advanced Cantonese course that starts next month.
example.traditional: 我報咗高級廣東話班，下個月開課。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou3 zo2 gou1 kap1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 baan1 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when advanced means at or close to the current state of the art.

example.english: This phone uses the most advanced chip.
example.traditional: 呢部手機用咗最先進嘅晶片。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jung6 zo2 zeoi3 sin1 zeon3 ge3 zing1 pin3
